description:
Sends feedback straight to the DocStar team. Use it when the user wants to report a bug, request a feature, flag wrong or missing docs, or share praise about DocStar or this MCP server. Write the message in the user's words and add any useful context, such as the tool or endpoint involved and what went wrong. Who sent it (user and organization) is taken from the signed-in user's token, never from the body. Returns 200 once delivered; 400 for an invalid body; 502 if it couldn't be delivered, in which case tell the user and try again later. Authenticate with the proxy_auth_token header (an `Authorization: Bearer hm_...` DocStar API token or a DocStar JWT is also accepted).
Body fields:
message (string, required) - The feedback, 1 to 5000 characters.type (string, optional) - One of bug, feature_request, docs, praise, other; default other.collectionId (string, optional) - The collection the feedback is about, if any.context (object, optional) - Extra details, e.g. the tool or endpoint used, the request and the error. POST https://api.docstar.io/feedback/ai

message.description: e.g. get_api_docs didn't list the MCP Server module's new endpoints

name: send_feedback_to_docstar
